notes: Human Foods Program letter (matching the diamond-herpanacine-pa-inc precedent) charging that disease-treatment citations on the firm's website (cancer-related research/news links) for three named mushroom-extract dietary supplements make them unapproved new drugs and misbranded (502(f)(1)) for lacking adequate directions for lay use. Unlike diamond-herpanacine, an on-site facility inspection did occur ('conducted an inspection of your facility located at 110 W. High St., Woodbury, TN 37190'), so location_contains is populated even though the charged violations are marketing-based rather than CGMP. Mushroom species names cited in the research headers (Trametes Versicolor, Inonotus obliquus, Ganoderma lucidum) are included in organisms per the abbott-laboratories/Similac-probiotic precedent, which lists genus-species names stated in the letter regardless of contamination context.
